text_block_list.text:
The day of the Japan Cup is here. Narita
Brian
resolves to win the race and go
speak with Biwa
Hayahide.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Хиши Амадзон is among today's
opponents. It's
their first G1 rematch
since last year's Arima
Kinen.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
She asks Нарита Брайан what her racing life
will look
like from now on...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Нарита Брайан answers that she's going to
keep
running and continue to be a
competitor. With
both holding strong to
their convictions, their
one-on-one
begins!
text_block_list.name: Монолог
